methodology.title: Learn the delivery model before changing the plan.
methodology.description: Translate the public collection-led system into account-level hypotheses, assigned work, release gates, and a quarterly decision. Confirm partner scope and capacity directly with Mike.

technical.title: Protect discovery, consistency, and the release path.
technical.description: Use the HTTP/HTML sample to identify specific checks, then validate indexation in Search Console and behavior in a rendered crawl. A crawlable response is one piece of evidence, not the whole diagnosis.

keywords.title: Give each commercial intent a deliberate owner.
keywords.description: The public sitemap contains several nearby service-page families. Compare the query sets, search results, and conversion roles before deciding to differentiate, consolidate, or expand a page.

collections.title: Ship a useful buying destination, then earn the right to scale.
collections.description: Start with distinct intent and enough relevant products. Align the brief, collection rules, copy, links, canonical behavior, and measurement before treating page velocity as progress.

onpage.title: Review the whole promise-to-proof-to-action sequence.
onpage.description: A title and H1 should set an accurate expectation. The page should then support that promise with useful detail, attributable evidence, and a clear next step. Changes below are proposals for review.

architecture.title: Reinforce commercial pages with relevant paths and proof.
architecture.description: Prioritize contextually useful service → case study and resource → service links. Use a full rendered graph and GSC to validate orphan risk before making site-wide architecture claims.

schema.title: Validate the facts and eligibility, not just the JSON.
schema.description: The sample already contains multiple structured-data types. Review whether entities match visible content, whether references are coherent, and whether each type is eligible for its intended search feature.

aeo.title: Treat readiness as an input and observed answers as a separate test.
aeo.description: Clear entities, accessible information, first-party proof, and trustworthy mentions are inspectable signals. Platform inclusion needs a defined query set, recorded conditions, repeated tests, and honest uncertainty.

content.title: Every brief needs an audience, a commercial job, and a QA owner.
content.description: Coordinate useful supporting content within the agreed account scope. Edit AI-assisted drafts for accuracy, brand voice, specificity, and source freshness before review and release.

authority.title: Earn evidence that makes the brand easier to trust.
authority.description: Choose relevant contributions, data, expert participation, and attributable coverage. Validate existing mentions and the account’s link-building scope before proposing a campaign.

community.title: Useful participation comes before a mention target.
community.description: Listen to the questions, respect each community’s rules, disclose relevant relationships, and contribute where there is real expertise. Measure referrals and mentions without claiming that a post caused AI inclusion.

shopping.title: Fix eligibility and feed truth before testing presentation.
shopping.description: Validate Merchant Center diagnostics, identifiers, price and stock consistency, and free-listing eligibility. Then test product titles or images in a controlled cohort with account data.

cro.title: Use business outcomes to refine the search opportunity.
cro.description: For Shopify clients, connect landing-page cohorts to transactions, net revenue, inventory, and margin. For the SEOasis agency site, track qualified leads and booked calls as a separate funnel.

competitors.title: The differentiator has to survive beyond the headline.
competitors.description: AI/AEO messaging appears across the sampled peer set. Make the fulfillment model tangible through collection briefs, accountable QA, direct communication, and documented quarterly learning.

measurement.title: Report the decision, not just the metric.
measurement.description: Agree on baselines, attribution, and definitions before connecting platforms. Every weekly update and client report should explain what changed, what remains uncertain, and the next action with an owner.
